items.source: Returns the "headers" condition of this RequestMappingInfo; or instance with 0 header expressions, never null.
items.translation: 返回此RequestMappingInfo实例的"headers"条件；若没有头表达式，则返回包含 0 个头表达式的实例，绝不会为null。

items.source:
Returns a new instance with the union of the header expressions
from "this" and the "other" instance.
items.translation: 返回一个新实例，该实例包含“this”和“other”实例的头部表达式的并集。

items.source: Uses of HeadersRequestCondition in org.springframework.web.reactive.result.condition
Uses of HeadersRequestCondition in org.springframework.web.reactive.result.method
A logical conjunction (' && ') request condition that matches a request against a set of header expressions with syntax defined in RequestMapping.headers().
items.translation: 一个逻辑与 (`' && '`) 请求条件，用于根据在RequestMapping.headers()中定义的语法将请求与一组头表达式进行匹配。

items.source: RequestCondition and implementations for matching requests based on different criteria.
items.translation: RequestCondition以及用于根据不同标准匹配请求的实现。

items.source: Returns "this" instance if the request matches all expressions; or null otherwise.
items.translation: 如果请求匹配所有表达式，则返回 "this" 实例；否则返回 null。
处理器方法处理的底层架构。

items.source: Compare to another condition based on header expressions.
items.translation: 根据头部表达式与另一个条件进行比较。
